description: Conditionally loaded reference node graph. The entry risk judgment selects the lane: Low takes the low-fast-path single-node exclusive lane, and an explicit Oracle request or Medium/High takes the oracle lane with the common entry. When a node when is satisfied, load its full path together with its requires edges, and do not load unrelated nodes. The full description of the load conditions is owned by the Reference loading section in SKILL.md.

entryContract.firstToolCall: Read exactly one lane entry node — low-fast-path when risk=Low, otherwise common
entryContract.responseHeader: risk=<Low|Medium|High> lane=<low-fast-path|oracle> nodes=[node ids actually Read]
entryContract.appliesTo: both implementation requests and explanation·plan-only requests
entryContract.loadConditionRule: Read when as the decision point, not the deliverable stage — load it the moment you make the decision that node owns, and the same holds when you answer only with examples·structure·plans without writing files. If applicability is ambiguous, load. Whether to skip a load is not a judgment call.

lanes.escalation: immediately disqualified when a policy question·new contract·architecture decision appears — promote to the oracle lane

lanes.when: an explicit Oracle request or Medium/High

nodes.when: risk=Low — load only this node
